scope: One operational environment and its approved change controls

canonical_sources.owns: Accepted desired state and mutation authority

gates.required_evidence: Preflight, stop/recovery path, and post-change behavior bound to the exact target

secrets.delivery: provider-managed injection to the approved process
secrets.artifact_scan: non-revealing scan over changed durable operational artifacts
secrets.exposure_response: invoke the credential response owner and stop self-controlled propagation
secrets.forensic_quarantine: restricted incident store with named access, retention, and audit
secrets.clean_context: fresh coordination and execution context after a non-secret canary
secrets.encrypted_envelopes: allowed only when the destination exclusively controls decryption

program.trigger: persistent coordinated rollout across environments or shared state
program.repair_authority: change owner independent of the invalidated rollout control

policy.reporting: change outcome with target, artifact, recovery, and live-state receipts
